decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won the gold medal from the Deutsches Brotinstitut again in 2023 and 2024 and is presented as a flagship, so it clearly exceeds the firm's aspiration level and gives no reason for problemistic search.

The dark barley malt rye bread is the only one of the four new breads that survived the 2024 pruning and still has its own page, which suggests results that meet the aspiration level at low cost within the firm's core bread competence.
The marzipan stollen complements the award-winning stollen line in the seasonal and gift segment and has stayed visible on its own page, so with no sign of a shortfall management will keep it.
